seoTitle: Table Joiner: VLOOKUP-Style Join of Two CSVs
metaDescription: Join two CSV tables on a key column with inner, left, right or full join. Reports unmatched rows. Free and private.
intro: Matches rows of two tables on a key and returns one table with the columns of both, like VLOOKUP but for every column.
why:
Spreadsheets split information across files: customers in one, orders in another. A join puts it back together. Choose the key in each table, ignore case and spaces if needed, and pick how to treat rows without a partner.

If the right table has several rows for a key, the left row repeats once per match, as in a database. Columns with the same name get a _right suffix. The summary counts unmatched rows on both sides, which is the quickest check of a key problem.
howTo: Paste the left table and the right table.
Type the key column of each side.
Choose left, inner, right or full join.
Copy or download the joined CSV.

faq.a: Left keeps every row of the first table, filling blanks where there is no match. Inner keeps only matches.

faq.q: Does it match numbers like 1 and 01?
Can I join on two columns?
faq.a: Merge the columns into one key first.
